data.revised_prompt:
Create a clean 2D game FX sprite sheet with exactly 2 rows by 2 columns, four animation frames, centered in each cell. Use the provided guide only for placement/centering and cell boundaries; do not include any guide lines, borders, labels, safe-area marks, or extra UI. Background outside the FX must be solid #FF00FF (pure magenta). Theme: ocean lagoon fantasy special-card trigger effect, elegant and readable at small size, not an explosion.

Frame 1 (top-left): small warm coral-pink glow with a faint aqua center, soft bloom, subtle pearl sheen.
Frame 2 (top-right): soft coral and turquoise petal rays unfolding into a circular chrysanthemum-like flower, delicate and luminous.
Frame 3 (bottom-left): full lagoon light flower, coral-colored bloom with thin seafoam halo, pearl glints, subtle wave shimmer, refined and magical.
Frame 4 (bottom-right): coral rays fading into soft aqua sparkles and tiny bubbles, dissipating gently while remaining centered.

Constraints: effect only; no playing card, no explosion, no fire, no smoke, no fragments, no tearing, no text, no icons. Keep each frame consistently scaled and contained within the central 65 percent of its cell, with nothing crossing cell edges. HD fantasy card-game VFX, crisp silhouette, luminous coral/aqua palette, smooth gradients, transparent-looking glow treatment against magenta background.
